items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: there's another clarinet player named Blue. Blue was from St. Louis.

ctx.x: Yeah. I just had the 78 at home. I've got it home. But you see, Jelly Roll, he had these big ideas which are very good, and during the time we were playing at the Rose Danceland, he imported Omer Simeon from New York and there's another clarinet player named Blue. Blue was from St. Louis. And --
You mean Omer Simeon he imported from New Orleans.
